units.rawText: The Oasis, Restaurant.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Restaurant.

spans.text: The Oasis, Restaurant.

units.rawText: Bonneville hums a tune with levity as she sends a fifth piece of steak into her mouth.
units.displayText: Bonneville hums a tune with levity as she sends a fifth piece of steak into her mouth.

spans.text: Bonneville hums a tune with levity as she sends a fifth piece of steak into her mouth.

units.rawText: Man, the cooking here is really something else.
units.displayText: Man, the cooking here is really something else.

spans.text: Man, the cooking here is really something else.

units.rawText: So long as you like it. How's life at the Oasis been treating you, Bonneville?
units.displayText: So long as you like it. How's life at the Oasis been treating you, Bonneville?

spans.text: So long as you like it. How's life at the Oasis been treating you, Bonneville?

units.rawText: Not bad, all things considered. I think I'm more or less happy with everything apart from having to scrap a few bikes.
units.displayText: Not bad, all things considered. I think I'm more or less happy with everything apart from having to scrap a few bikes.

spans.text: Not bad, all things considered. I think I'm more or less happy with everything apart from having to scrap a few bikes.

units.rawText: I'm surprised, though... you haven't told anyone else about my identity?
units.displayText: I'm surprised, though... you haven't told anyone else about my identity?

spans.text: I'm surprised, though... you haven't told anyone else about my identity?

units.rawText: No. I wouldn't want you or Shale to get any special treatment.
units.displayText: No. I wouldn't want you or Shale to get any special treatment.

spans.text: No. I wouldn't want you or Shale to get any special treatment.

units.rawText: And if you get slapped with any restrictions, you wouldn't be able to go for a drive whenever you wanted, right?
units.displayText: And if you get slapped with any restrictions, you wouldn't be able to go for a drive whenever you wanted, right?

spans.text: And if you get slapped with any restrictions, you wouldn't be able to go for a drive whenever you wanted, right?

units.rawText: The redhead whistles in recognition.
units.displayText: The redhead whistles in recognition.

spans.text: The redhead whistles in recognition.

units.rawText: Not bad at all, Professor. You keep raising my opinion of ya.
units.displayText: Not bad at all, Professor. You keep raising my opinion of ya.

spans.text: Not bad at all, Professor. You keep raising my opinion of ya.

units.rawText: I do quite like this patch of road. The horrid roads in the other sectors are like off-road cross-country nightmares in comparison.
units.displayText: I do quite like this patch of road. The horrid roads in the other sectors are like off-road cross-country nightmares in comparison.

spans.text: I do quite like this patch of road. The horrid roads in the other sectors are like off-road cross-country nightmares in comparison.

units.rawText: Sailing down a smooth road does do a good job of easing the mind.
units.displayText: Sailing down a smooth road does do a good job of easing the mind.

spans.text: Sailing down a smooth road does do a good job of easing the mind.

units.rawText: Oh, Professor, you truly are after my own heart!
units.displayText: Oh, Professor, you truly are after my own heart!

spans.text: Oh, Professor, you truly are after my own heart!

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Bonneville springs to her feet, her eyes burning and inescapable.
units.displayText: Bonneville springs to her feet, her eyes burning and inescapable.

spans.text: Bonneville springs to her feet, her eyes burning and inescapable.

units.rawText: The feeling of the wind in your face as you go faster and faster beyond the limit—addicting, isn't it?
units.displayText: The feeling of the wind in your face as you go faster and faster beyond the limit—addicting, isn't it?

spans.text: The feeling of the wind in your face as you go faster and faster beyond the limit—addicting, isn't it?

units.rawText: I'm sure you've taken notice of my bike. With the mods done on it, it's got both the speed and the feel! Wanna give it a spin, Professor?
units.displayText: I'm sure you've taken notice of my bike. With the mods done on it, it's got both the speed and the feel! Wanna give it a spin, Professor?

spans.text: I'm sure you've taken notice of my bike. With the mods done on it, it's got both the speed and the feel! Wanna give it a spin, Professor?

units.rawText: Haha, I still have some work to do later. Next time, for sure.
units.displayText: Haha, I still have some work to do later. Next time, for sure.

spans.text: Haha, I still have some work to do later. Next time, for sure.

units.rawText: Oh, to speak of it, I do have a piece of news that might interest you as a racing Doll...
units.displayText: Oh, to speak of it, I do have a piece of news that might interest you as a racing Doll...

spans.text: Oh, to speak of it, I do have a piece of news that might interest you as a racing Doll...

units.rawText: I catch a glimpse of the reality that lies underneath Bonneville's disguise.
units.displayText: I catch a glimpse of the reality that lies underneath Bonneville's disguise.

spans.text: I catch a glimpse of the reality that lies underneath Bonneville's disguise.

units.rawText: It was for but a moment, but a touch of melancholy flashes across Bonneville's face as she hears the word "racing". It is soon covered up by her usual smiling countenance.
units.displayText: It was for but a moment, but a touch of melancholy flashes across Bonneville's face as she hears the word "racing". It is soon covered up by her usual smiling countenance.

spans.text: It was for but a moment, but a touch of melancholy flashes across Bonneville's face as she hears the word "racing". It is soon covered up by her usual smiling countenance.

units.rawText: She straightens up, returning to her chair.
units.displayText: She straightens up, returning to her chair.

spans.text: She straightens up, returning to her chair.

units.rawText: What other good news do you have for me?
units.displayText: What other good news do you have for me?

spans.text: What other good news do you have for me?

units.rawText: ...Croque's made some new conclusions from her research on power systems. Chances are it'll make your bike even faster.
units.displayText: ...Croque's made some new conclusions from her research on power systems. Chances are it'll make your bike even faster.

spans.text: ...Croque's made some new conclusions from her research on power systems. Chances are it'll make your bike even faster.

units.rawText: Sounds good. I'll go visit the Engineering Dept when I have time. Thanks, Prof!
units.displayText: Sounds good. I'll go visit the Engineering Dept when I have time. Thanks, Prof!

spans.text: Sounds good. I'll go visit the Engineering Dept when I have time. Thanks, Prof!

units.rawText: She finishes her root bear, stretching in her chair.
units.displayText: She finishes her root bear, stretching in her chair.

spans.text: She finishes her root bear, stretching in her chair.

units.rawText: Ah—that hit the spot. Let's head out after a bit.
units.displayText: Ah—that hit the spot. Let's head out after a bit.

spans.text: Ah—that hit the spot. Let's head out after a bit.

units.rawText: Bonneville.
units.displayText: Bonneville.

spans.text: Bonneville.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: If there's something you're holding back, please share it with me if you feel comfortable. I might be able to offer some assistance.
units.displayText: If there's something you're holding back, please share it with me if you feel comfortable. I might be able to offer some assistance.

spans.text: If there's something you're holding back, please share it with me if you feel comfortable. I might be able to offer some assistance.

units.rawText: ...Well, nothing escapes the Professor. Sharp to a terrifying degree.
units.displayText: ...Well, nothing escapes the Professor. Sharp to a terrifying degree.

spans.text: ...Well, nothing escapes the Professor. Sharp to a terrifying degree.

units.rawText: She avoids my eyes, hands on her chin and deep in thought. She still holds a fork in her hand, fidgeting with it.
units.displayText: She avoids my eyes, hands on her chin and deep in thought. She still holds a fork in her hand, fidgeting with it.

spans.text: She avoids my eyes, hands on her chin and deep in thought. She still holds a fork in her hand, fidgeting with it.

units.rawText: <size=28>And that's exactly why I have to watch my words like so when I'm with you, Professor...</size>
units.displayText: And that's exactly why I have to watch my words like so when I'm with you, Professor...

spans.text: And that's exactly why I have to watch my words like so when I'm with you, Professor...

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: I'm saying—if I poured it all out to you right now, you'd come to know all about my past just like that. That doesn't feel fair!
units.displayText: I'm saying—if I poured it all out to you right now, you'd come to know all about my past just like that. That doesn't feel fair!

spans.text: I'm saying—if I poured it all out to you right now, you'd come to know all about my past just like that. That doesn't feel fair!

units.rawText: Bonneville gestures with her fork, drawing the shape of a circle in the air.
units.displayText: Bonneville gestures with her fork, drawing the shape of a circle in the air.

spans.text: Bonneville gestures with her fork, drawing the shape of a circle in the air.

units.rawText: Alright, how about this? If you are really so interested, then go around and ask about it yourself, hmm?
units.displayText: Alright, how about this? If you are really so interested, then go around and ask about it yourself, hmm?

spans.text: Alright, how about this? If you are really so interested, then go around and ask about it yourself, hmm?

units.rawText: Is this some sort of test for me?
units.displayText: Is this some sort of test for me?

spans.text: Is this some sort of test for me?

units.rawText: Is that really a test for you, Professor? Let's just call it an entrée, a little game.
units.displayText: Is that really a test for you, Professor? Let's just call it an entrée, a little game.

spans.text: Is that really a test for you, Professor? Let's just call it an entrée, a little game.

units.rawText: I will give it my all.
units.displayText: I will give it my all.

spans.text: I will give it my all.

units.rawText: I look forward to seeing you next, then. It was a lovely meal, thank you for the treat.
units.displayText: I look forward to seeing you next, then. It was a lovely meal, thank you for the treat.

spans.text: I look forward to seeing you next, then. It was a lovely meal, thank you for the treat.

units.rawText: She puts her cutlery back in their place, waving at me as she steps outside.
units.displayText: She puts her cutlery back in their place, waving at me as she steps outside.

spans.text: She puts her cutlery back in their place, waving at me as she steps outside.

units.rawText: The sounds of tires against the pavement and a roaring engine arise. I look in the sound's direction to see a blazing head of hair waving in the air like a standard, its owner speeding away into the horizon.
units.displayText: The sounds of tires against the pavement and a roaring engine arise. I look in the sound's direction to see a blazing head of hair waving in the air like a standard, its owner speeding away into the horizon.

spans.text: The sounds of tires against the pavement and a roaring engine arise. I look in the sound's direction to see a blazing head of hair waving in the air like a standard, its owner speeding away into the horizon.
